name: XDG Desktop Portals
shortDesc: Standardized desktop integration interface for screen sharing, file pickers, and sandboxed apps.
detailedDesc: Critical for Discord / OBS / browser screen sharing and GTK/Qt file dialogs under Wayland.

phase.title: Desktop QoL & Ricing Utilities
phase.description: The fine-grained ricing details: clipboard managers, color pickers, screenshot annotation, polkit, portals, and fonts.

packages.name: xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland (Recommended for Hyprland)
packages.description: Custom portal backend for Hyprland providing hardware-accelerated screen sharing via PipeWire and window sharing.
pros: Essential for WebRTC / Discord screen sharing

packages.name: xdg-desktop-portal-gtk (Recommended Companion)
packages.description: Fallback GTK portal for standard file open/save dialogs, app choosers, and notifications.
pros: Clean file chooser dialogs for Flatpak and native apps

packages.name: xdg-desktop-portal-wlr
packages.description: Generic wlroots portal implementation used by Sway and River compositors.
cons: Fewer custom animation/window hooks than hyprland portal
